messages.label: Step 0 (listening_for_discover) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_request. Cond: dhcpv4.is_dhcp_discover() and dhcpv4.chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dhcpv4.dut_iface_mac)
Step 1 (listening_for_request) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_dut_udp. Cond: dhcpv4.is_dhcp_request() and dhcpv4.chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dhcpv4.dut_iface_mac)

Step 2 (listening_for_dut_udp) pass trigger — transitions to pass. Cond: udp.dst_ip == expected.unused_routed_ip_be and udp.eth_src_equals(expected.dhcpv4.dut_iface_mac) and udp.eth_dst_equals(expected.router_mac)
